cohort: 216 pregnant women diagnosed with placenta previa
finding: The prevalence of placenta previa was 0.84%, and it was associated with previous cesarean delivery, multiple gestations, and increased maternal age.
mod_finding: Of the patients with placenta previa, 59.7% had uncomplicated elective cesarean delivery at 37-38 weeks of gestation.
gest_age: Ranged from time of diagnosis to 37-38 weeks
